scope: Independent runtime and integration review before repository handoff

findings.problem: Startup SHA or CUDA failure only changed HTTP readiness while the scheduler still consumed persisted queued work.
findings.resolution: A failed startup verification now holds the queue. Each queued model bundle is verified before an expected-ID atomic claim; changed model file metadata invalidates verification cache.

findings.problem: An uncaught queue or publication error could kill the scheduler while static readiness continued admitting new jobs.
findings.resolution: Scheduler fatal state is observable, readiness and liveness reflect thread health, new admissions stop, remaining queued work is held and a sanitized durable diagnostic is written.

findings.problem: The model watchdog synchronously queried SQLite for cancellation; database contention could delay a hard compute deadline by the SQL busy timeout.
findings.resolution: The watchdog reads a per-active-job memory event. Cancellation is durably recorded and then signals the event; registration and late-cancel races have explicit coverage.

findings.problem: A late cancellation rewrote the top-level decision but could retain an accepted nested contract projection or operational metadata; finish also mutated the caller's input object.
findings.resolution: Publication deep-copies the result, preserves reason history, makes every canceled projection review-only and removes unpublished audit/drift metadata. Engine operational side effects are deferred until a terminal published result is projected.

findings.problem: Startup recovery or thread-start failures could retain scheduler ownership, and the same instance could be started twice.
findings.resolution: Failed startup releases ownership and backend resources; duplicate startup is rejected and shutdown does not release ownership while a scheduler could still publish.

findings.problem: A non-ASCII Bearer header caused hmac.compare_digest to raise TypeError and returned an HTTP server error.
findings.resolution: Malformed non-ASCII authorization returns 401. Server bearer tokens must be distinct ASCII strings without whitespace and meet the minimum length.

findings.problem: Unperformed reread requirements were held by Engine.run but could disappear when Service.result freshly projected the same snapshot.
findings.resolution: Structured unresolved_rereads remain a review barrier during subsequent result reads, even if a policy gateway would otherwise accept the fields.

findings.problem: Invalidating evidence behind a conflicted claim did not retract that claim; obsolete conflicts permanently poisoned fresh source-backed readings.
findings.resolution: Inactive evidence retracts conflicted automatic claims too. Once real opposition is gone, surviving historic conflicts are retired without automatic resurrection. Fresh proof/new claim is required; independent fields and protected human decisions are preserved.

findings.problem: Confirmed critical audit outcomes were logged but did not directly quarantine the active binding, leaving the audit-to-risk safety action disconnected.
findings.resolution: Reviewer-only HTTP outcome bridge validates document evidence; outcome, binding quarantine and quarantine event commit in one SQLite transaction. Active F08 policies immediately become review-only. Identical replay is idempotent and cannot undo authorized clearance; no gold or promotion occurs.

remaining_acceptance_requirements: Run the complete frozen integration suite after all audit branches are integrated.
Build and run the pinned Linux container on the target NVIDIA GPU.
Measure native 0.8B/4B hybrid accuracy, abstention, latency and memory on independent Russian documents.
Do not promote software tests or synthetic smoke to production quality qualification.

targeted_verification.execution: Windows Python3.12 fixture-only; local ASGI TestClient outside sandbox
